description.value: Established in 2013, Formosa Tea Café is a locally owned Taiwanese bubble tea shop in Kelowna serving authentic milk teas, iced teas, cream drinks, fresh fruit smoothies, and specialty coffee — most teas sourced from USDA-certified organic beans and leaves tracing back to Tai-Chung, Taiwan. The café partners with local Kelowna businesses to feature regional products and artworks. Cyclists on Harvey Avenue will find a wide drinks menu including hot, iced, and blended options, plus delivery service for the surrounding area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM record: phone (778) 478-3737, address 6-2070 Harvey Ave., and the website URL all match OSM tags. The site establishes this as an active Kelowna bubble tea café (established 2013, copyright © 2026, OSM check_date 2025-11-11) with online ordering and delivery, confirming takeout. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established café on a main Kelowna corridor offering a wide drinks menu and online ordering — a legitimate refreshment stop for touring cyclists even without confirmed cycling-specific amenities.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM addr:unit=6 is reflected in the website address format '6-2070 Harvey Ave.' — no discrepancy, just a formatting difference. Email formosateacafe@gmail.com found on website but not present in OSM tags.
